text: 太快了，有点恍惚
en: Too fast, a bit dazed.

text: 不管承不承认，四十岁已经来了。
en: Whether you admit it or not, forty has arrived.

text: 四十岁，有些人负债累累、有些人身价上亿、有些人妻离子散、有些人家庭和睦、有些人成为上市企业负责人管着几万人、有些人在体制内小心翼翼的端着铁饭碗、有些人失业了只能去送外卖，开网约车，摆地摊。
en: At forty, some are up to their necks in debt, some are worth hundreds of millions, some have lost their families, some enjoy domestic harmony, some have become heads of listed companies managing tens of thousands of people, some cling nervously to their iron rice bowls within the system, and some, having lost their jobs, can only deliver takeaways, drive ride-hailing cars, or run street stalls.

text: 芸芸众生，无论那个角色，这就是你我的四十岁，无奈也罢，焦虑也罢，这就是现实。
en: All living beings, whatever the role, this is our forty, whether resigned or anxious, this is reality.

text: 四十岁了，上有老，下有小，摔倒了爬起来，继续前行，因为我们没有退路。
en: At forty, with the elderly above and the young below, we pick ourselves up after falling and press on, because we have no way back.

text: 不做销售。
en: Do not go into sales.

text: 这一行，全是消耗，在越来越讲究资源互换的时代，你明白吧，你就是没有任何资源才去做的销售啊。
en: This line of work is pure depletion. In an era that increasingly prizes the exchange of resources, you see, it is precisely because you have no resources at all that you ended up in sales.

text: 今天有点别的感悟，补充几点。
en: I have had a few other insights today; let me add a few points.

text: 1、少年时候一定要勉强自己。
en: 1. In youth you must push yourself.

text: 上学是平凡人自己一生中改变命运，有个好前途最重要也是最公平的一段时期。
en: School is the most important and fairest period in an ordinary person's life for changing their destiny and securing a good future.

text: 自我加压，有进步你享受所有成就感，没进步你也没吃亏，谁也抢不走你的功劳。
en: Impose pressure on yourself: if you improve, you enjoy all the sense of achievement; if you do not, you lose nothing either, and no one can take your credit away.

text: 分数只和自己的智商+努力有关系。
en: Marks relate only to your own intelligence plus effort.

text: 只要你在小学时代表现出来优秀，家庭一定会倾注资源培养你。
en: As long as you show excellence as a pupil, your family will surely invest resources to nurture you.

text: 家庭矛盾也会减少和化解。
en: Family conflicts will also lessen and resolve.

text: 2、工作以后一定不要勉强自己。
en: 2. After you start working, you must not push yourself.

text: 工作是个修罗场。
en: Work is a brutal battleground.

text: 你拿着自己的文凭开始混社会的时候，工作单位和学校可就不一样了。
en: When you take your diploma and start making your way in society, the workplace is nothing like school.

text: 换职业，换单位，换城市，都有各种可能，工作中的别扭和难受，不要一味承受，把过去上学的时候使劲往脑子里装知识的那个劲儿，换成往脑子里装信息，一切强信息强关系，都是指向让自己早点找到适合的发展道路。
en: Changing careers, employers, or cities all hold various possibilities. Do not simply endure the awkwardness and distress at work; swap the drive you once had at school for cramming knowledge into your head with a drive for cramming information into your head. All strong information and strong connections point towards helping you find a suitable path of development sooner.

text: 中年以后，要保重身体，关键是心态。
en: After middle age, take care of your health; the key is your state of mind.

text: 平静的喜乐胜万金，说几点，互勉：
en: A calm joy surpasses ten thousand pieces of gold. Let me offer a few points, as mutual encouragement:

text: 3、不要在意尊严。
en: 3. Do not fuss over dignity.

text: 可以不要脸。
en: You can be shameless.

text: 人和人很多矛盾，很多内耗是为了尊严，有时候你可以不用这么在意，不用非要别人说你好。
en: Many conflicts between people, much internal friction, are for the sake of dignity. Sometimes you need not care so much, need not insist that others speak well of you.

text: 过得去就过，过不去拉到，烂尾就烂尾，自己好过就行。
en: If it can pass, let it pass; if it cannot, let it go; if it ends badly, so be it — as long as you are comfortable yourself.

text: 什么是“好”？
en: What is 'good'?

text: 工作的好没有极限。
en: The 'good' of work has no limit.

text: 在工作和生活里努力找寻一点意义，用来平衡努力和基本素质的维系就可以了。
en: Strive to find a little meaning in work and life, enough to balance effort with the maintenance of basic character.

text: 其他的都不必。
en: Nothing else is necessary.

text: 4、不要侃侃而谈。
en: 4. Do not hold forth.

text: 不要好为人师。
en: Do not be fond of preaching to others.

text: 没有人真正的看得起身边的人。
en: No one truly looks up to the people around them.

text: 说多了耗费自己心力，而且容易话赶话就承诺了你本不想去帮忙的事儿，过后都是内耗自己。
en: Talking too much drains your mental energy, and it is easy for one word to lead to another until you promise things you never meant to help with, all of which becomes internal friction afterwards.

text: 所以，少介入别人的因果，少在别人面前说那么多。
en: So, involve yourself less in others' karma, and speak less in front of others.

text: 在意你的都是想要依赖你的，有资源的人根本不在乎你说的什么。
en: Those who care about you are those who want to depend on you; people with resources simply do not care what you say.

text: 与其不断表演，还不如做一个观察者。
en: Rather than constantly performing, it is better to be an observer.

text: 5、家庭比爱情重要。
en: 5. Family matters more than love.

text: 健康比性重要。
en: Health matters more than sex.

text: 钱比感情重要。
en: Money matters more than feelings.

text: 性比感情实际。
en: Sex is more practical than feelings.

text: 6、永远不要在无意义的圈子里混，不花一分钱一分钟在无效的社交环境里消耗自己。
en: 6. Never hang about in meaningless circles, and do not spend a single penny or minute consuming yourself in ineffective social environments.

text: 7、不知道该干啥的时候，就收拾一切。
en: 7. When you do not know what to do, tidy everything up.

text: 收拾房间，收拾办公桌，收拾电脑里的东西。
en: Tidy the room, tidy the desk, tidy what is in the computer.

text: 这是一种修炼，达到身体和心灵的平衡，享受宁静，并且极大方便你的资源调配，你会越来越过得顺手。
en: This is a form of cultivation, achieving balance of body and mind, enjoying tranquillity, and greatly facilitating your allocation of resources; you will live more and more at ease.

text: 8、总有一天你会变的记性很差，极差。
en: 8. One day your memory will become very poor, extremely poor.

text: 所以要积极记录幸福和美好。
en: So you must actively record happiness and beauty.

text: 哪怕一句话。
en: Even a single sentence.

text: 这样的习惯会让你越来越平静祥和。
en: Such a habit will make you ever more calm and peaceful.

text: 9、在你不平静的时候，比如在你感受到很高兴或者很沮丧的时候，要去想一句话：你到底想怎样活着？
en: 9. When you are not at peace, such as when you feel very happy or very dejected, think of one sentence: how on earth do you want to live?

text: 这句话能帮助你快速平静，不会大喜大悲，而外人不知，只看到你睥睨的眼神与神秘的慈悲。
en: This sentence can help you calm down quickly, without great joy or sorrow, while outsiders, none the wiser, see only your disdainful gaze and mysterious compassion.

text: 10、接受随遇而安。
en: 10. Accept going with the flow.

text: 没有目标，放弃目标，偶尔被裹挟，遭遇突发状况。
en: No goals, giving up goals, occasionally being swept along, encountering sudden situations.

text: 这些不是你的错，但你要接受，然后，随遇而安。
en: These are not your fault, but you must accept them, and then go with the flow.

text: 11、总结：知分寸，不多言；明进退，不好胜；守底线，保平安。
en: 11. In summary: know your bounds and do not over-talk; understand advance and retreat and do not crave victory; hold your bottom line and keep safe.

text: 不管做什么事，都一定要趁早，趁着那一股劲还在，想尽办法去做。
en: Whatever you do, you must do it early, while that surge of drive is still there, by whatever means you can.

text: 其实人是有性格差异的，有的人很早就想明白了自己要干什么，而有的人这一生庸庸碌碌，从未开始过。
en: In truth people differ in character: some work out early what they want to do, while others drift through life in mediocrity and never even begin.

text: 我在农村和城市都生活过很长一段时间。
en: I have lived in the countryside and in the city for long stretches.

text: 农村的生活告诉我，穷苦劳碌一生却从未改变的人有很多很多；城市的生活告诉我，你以为不会变的，可能明天就没了。
en: Life in the countryside told me there are very many who toil in poverty all their lives yet never change; life in the city told me that what you think will never change may be gone by tomorrow.

text: 我站在过去认为的未来，回看过去的现在，想清楚了很多事。
en: Standing at the future I once thought of as the future, looking back at the present of the past, I have thought many things through.

text: 其实，年轻人做与不做，都不一定成功。
en: In truth, whether young people act or not, they will not necessarily succeed.

text: 但如果他不去做，后面就彻底废掉了。
en: But if he does not act, he is completely finished afterwards.

text: 去做了哪怕失败了其实也没多大问题，经历一些历练反而容易找到方向。
en: Having acted, even if you fail, there is in fact no great problem; some experience instead makes it easier to find your direction.

text: 穷人家的孩子折腾是应该的，不折腾的话，边界就无法拓展，眼界也打不开，很容易在一个厂里拧一辈子螺丝，一转眼就被家庭困住，成家之后沦为“血包”，只能一辈子重复同样的工作。
en: Children of poor families ought to stir things up. If they do not, their boundaries cannot expand and their horizons cannot open; it is easy to spend a lifetime turning screws in a factory, and in the blink of an eye be trapped by family, and after starting a family become a 'blood pack', doomed to repeat the same work all life long.

text: 要变就趁早变，因为人生越往后就越身不由己。
en: If you are to change, change early, because the further life goes the less you belong to yourself.

text: 就像很多读者经常在后台私信问我：“先生，我以前愚钝，总是好吃懒做，现在四十好几了，家里孩子要上学，又有老人要养，经济压力很大，我该怎么办？
en: Just as many readers often message me privately via the backend: 'Sir, I was foolish before, always fond of good food and loath to work, and now I am well into my forties, with children at school and elderly to support, under great financial pressure — what should I do?'

text: 说实话，这种情况下已经没有太多出路了，因为局限本身已经形成了。
en: To be honest, in such a situation there is no longer much way out, because the limitation itself has already taken shape.

text: 如果工作本身还能糊口养家，那么多给自己一些喘息的时间和空间，别活得太累。
en: If the work itself can still feed and support the family, then give yourself more time and space to catch your breath, and do not live too wearily.

text: 因为到了这个年纪，真的想学什么也学不进去了，想做什么也身不由己了，哪怕发狠想做点什么，也会发现毫无头绪。
en: Because at this age, you truly cannot learn whatever you want to learn, and cannot act as you wish even if you want to; even if you steel yourself to do something, you will find yourself utterly at a loss.

text: 最后只能日复一日地面对同一个问题，过了一年又一年。
en: In the end you can only face the same problem day after day, year after year.

text: 这其实就是自己应该承受的。
en: This is in fact what one ought to bear oneself.

text: 有的人年轻时吃苦，等年纪大了就轻松一些；有的人年轻时过得爽，等年纪大了就难一些。
en: Some endure hardship in youth and find life easier when older; some live it up in youth and find it harder when older.

text: 只要你把自己抽离出来，去看待自己的每一个选择，其实就会非常清楚，这很正常，只是因为我们把自己代入其中，所以觉得不公平罢了。
en: As long as you detach yourself and look at each of your own choices, it will in fact be very clear — this is perfectly normal; it is only because we place ourselves inside it that we feel it is unfair.

text: 就像我现在回顾自己曾经做过的蠢事和遇到的倒霉事，我知道如果我不经历这些，尽早脱离祖祖辈辈的小农生活方式，这些情况依然会延续给我的后代。
en: Just as now, reviewing the foolish things I once did and the bad luck I met, I know that if I had not experienced these and shaken off the smallholder way of life of my ancestors early, these circumstances would still have passed on to my descendants.

text: 他们可能会被丢在农村，上一个很烂的学校，然后随着时间慢慢长大，到了城里发现自己啥也跟不上，学习不行，打工不行，连创业的本钱也没有。
en: They might be left in the countryside, attend a rotten school, then grow up slowly with time, and upon reaching the city find they cannot keep up with anything — no good at study, no good at labouring, not even the capital to start a business.

text: 我是从工厂里卷铺盖跑掉的那一批。
en: I was one of those who rolled up their bedding and ran away from the factory.

text: 那一年我毕业之后被学校卖到工厂实习。
en: That year, after graduating, I was sold by the school to the factory for an internship.

text: 进入工厂的第一个夜晚，我呆呆地坐在上下铺的角落，和一起来的四眼一起抽烟。
en: On the first night in the factory, I sat dazed in a corner of the bunk beds, smoking with Four Eyes, who had come along with me.

text: 我心里很压抑，觉得这不是我该过的生活，我不甘心自己挣扎了这么久，还要去从事这样枯燥无聊的工作。
en: I felt terribly oppressed, thinking this was not the life I should lead; I was unwilling to accept that after struggling so long I should still take up such dull and boring work.

text: 哪怕去做乞丐，我也不想待在这里。
en: I would rather be a beggar than stay here.

text: 然后我和四眼就连夜卷起铺盖，提着桶，一路逃回了学校。
en: Then Four Eyes and I rolled up our bedding overnight, bucket in hand, and fled all the way back to school.

text: 这是我第一次向这个社会反抗他们给我们安排的不合理生活。
en: This was my first act of resistance against the unreasonable life this society had arranged for us.

text: 那一段路很长，灯火照耀在桥上，那些听话懂事的人都已经在宿舍睡着了，而我们还在拖着疲惫的身体，去往一个未知的地方。
en: That road was very long, lamplight shone on the bridge, those obedient and sensible ones were already asleep in the dormitory, while we were still dragging our weary bodies towards an unknown place.

text: 但那一刻，我知道我们是自由的。
en: But at that moment, I knew we were free.

text: 不愿意接受他人给你的安排，就要承受很多额外的苦，这大概就是大多数人害怕的事情吧。
en: To refuse the arrangements others make for you is to bear much extra suffering — that is probably what most people are afraid of.

text: 没有了工作怎么办？
en: What if there is no work?

text: 没有了收入怎么办？
en: What if there is no income?

text: 年纪大了还没有结婚怎么办？
en: What if you are old and still unmarried?

text: 以后没有孩子养老怎么办？
en: What if there are no children to care for you in old age?

text: 其实，就算真的有这些，也未必真的如意。
en: In truth, even if you really had these things, they might not turn out as you wish.

text: 有工作的人，工资只够糊口，发现自己的能力一点点被磨没了，每天应付着各种毫无意义的琐事，开着让人窒息的会议，混一天是一天，工作反而成了枷锁。
en: Those with work earn only enough to get by, find their abilities worn away bit by bit, cope each day with all kinds of meaningless trivialities, sit through suffocating meetings, muddle through one day at a time, and work becomes a shackle instead.

text: 结婚有了孩子，最后天天吵架，才发现自己根本不适合步入婚姻。
en: Those who marry and have children end up quarrelling every day, and only then realise they were never suited to marriage.

text: 扯来扯去最后离了婚，才发现一个人带着孩子也能过得挺好。
en: After all the dragging back and forth they finally divorce, only to find they can live quite well alone with the child.

text: 至于未来的孩子，能不能养活自己都是个问题，也就没了那个“有人养老”的念头。
en: As for future children, whether they can even support themselves is a question, so the notion of 'someone to care for me in old age' disappears.

text: 毕竟到了我们这一代，那种封建的思维已经少了。
en: After all, by our generation, that feudal mindset has already faded.

text: 我们这一代人吃着外卖、熬着夜、生着各种闷气，能够长命百岁也算是生物奇迹了。
en: Our generation eats takeaways, stays up late, and harbours all kinds of pent-up resentment; to live to a hundred would be a biological miracle.

text: 与其去想那些以后的事情，为那些可能不存在的东西担忧，还不如把当下的这一分一秒过好。
en: Rather than dwell on those future matters and worry about things that may not exist, it is better to live well the present minute.

text: 真的到了我这个年纪，已经看透了，什么未来会更好还是更坏，其实都是虚妄。
en: Truly, at my age, one has seen through it: that the future will be better or worse is in fact all vanity.

text: 能够趁着你还有味觉，身体健康，思维清晰，抽空十几分钟去吃自己爱吃的，去一个人待一会儿，去和自己喜欢的人待在一起，就算是没白活了。
en: While you still have your sense of taste, a healthy body, and a clear mind, to steal a dozen minutes to eat what you love, to be alone for a while, to be with those you like — that counts as not having lived in vain.

text: 及时行乐，当下即永恒。
en: Seize pleasure while you can; the present is eternity.

text: 以后谁能料定呢？
en: Who can predict the future?

text: 等你有钱有闲，吃得起贵的东西了，可能到那时候身体已经跟不上了；等你老了退休了，想起来要去某个地方，可能腿脚已经不利索了。
en: When you have money and leisure and can afford expensive things, your body may no longer keep up by then; when you are old and retired and think of going somewhere, your legs may no longer be nimble.

text: 以后是瞬息万变的，你能够抓住的只有当下。
en: The future changes in a flash; all you can grasp is the present.

text: 所以，当下就干，哪怕很烂也没关系，因为这是唯一的出路。
en: So act now, even if it is terrible, for it is the only way out.

text: 真的等以后，你条件具足了，可能这个门槛又高了。
en: Truly, if you wait for the future until your conditions are met, that threshold may have risen again.

text: 在你还年轻的时候，瞎搞一些事情反倒比较容易成功。
en: When you are still young, messing about with things is instead more likely to succeed.

text: 等你什么都会了，反倒是限制一大堆，规规矩矩的，明明什么都做对了，但就是什么也干不成了。
en: When you can do everything, there are instead a host of restrictions, all proper and rule-bound; clearly you have done everything right, yet you achieve nothing.

text: 我十七岁的时候创办了第一家公司，身上只有八百块钱。
en: When I was seventeen I founded my first company, with only eight hundred yuan on me.

text: 那时候我有一股莫名其妙的自信，而且我的生活成本极低，很多时候一天吃一顿蛋炒饭就能干一天的活，还能通宵熬到凌晨四五点。
en: Back then I had a baffling self-confidence, and my cost of living was extremely low; often a single plate of egg-fried rice a day was enough to work through the day, and I could stay up till four or five in the morning.

text: 很多原本不属于我的订单，就是靠着我能熬而且又廉价抢过来的。
en: Many orders that were not originally mine I snatched precisely by being able to endure and being cheap.

text: 但如今别说熬夜了，可能少吃一顿饭，都要低血糖倒在地上起不来。
en: But now, never mind staying up late — miss a single meal and I might collapse from low blood sugar and be unable to get up.

text: 我结婚的时候也是身无分文，各种参加路演，最后在婚礼前的两个礼拜，拿到了一笔创业贷款把婚给结了。
en: When I married I was also penniless; I went to all kinds of roadshows, and finally, two weeks before the wedding, secured a startup loan to pay for the marriage.

text: 而且这个日子还是我外婆找人算了一下，临时通知我的。
en: And the date was one my grandmother had someone calculate, and told me about at the last minute.

text: 然后我就拼命为了这个日子紧赶慢赶去筹备，也算是在最难的时候把这件大事给办了。
en: Then I scrambled to prepare for that date with all my might, and could be said to have got this great affair done even in the hardest of times.

text: 如果按我的性格，估计到五十岁都觉得自己准备得不够。
en: Had it been left to my nature, I expect I would still feel unprepared even at fifty.

text: 换做现在，我早已经对婚姻爱情这些东西都看透了。
en: Were it now, I would long ago have seen through marriage, love, and such things.

text: 要是当年我是现在的思维，肯定就是单身到老，去大理隐居做一个散人了。
en: If back then I had thought as I do now, I would surely have remained single to the end, retired to Dali to live as a recluse.

text: 而且我现在也离异性远远的，因为男男女女走得近，就会生出很多麻烦。
en: And now I also keep far from the opposite sex, because when men and women get close, much trouble arises.

text: 但这些事情唯独在你年轻的时候可以免疫，且不花任何成本就能爱上一个人。
en: But only in youth can you be immune to these things, and fall in love with someone at no cost at all.

text: 所以年纪越大，越是不相信婚姻，越是不相信爱情，因为早就已经习惯了自己一个人。
en: So the older you grow, the less you believe in marriage, the less you believe in love, because you have long since grown used to being alone.

text: 至于创业，如果我现在有一份稳定的工作，能够勉强糊口，估计我也没什么动力再去折腾了。
en: As for starting a business, if I now had a stable job that could just about feed me, I expect I would have little drive to stir things up again.

text: 因为我知道，打工最大的封锁其实就是信息和认知。
en: Because I know that the greatest lock on waged work is in fact information and cognition.

text: 通过高强度的工作压榨牛马的精力，然后把圈子一步步压缩，达到稳定且任劳任怨的状态。
en: Through high-intensity work it squeezes the energy of the beasts of burden, then narrows the circle step by step, until a stable and uncomplaining state is reached.

text: 哪怕有一些极为重要的信息偶然听到，也会听不懂甚至厌烦，但明明那些就是发财的核心机密。
en: Even if you happen to hear some extremely important information, you will fail to understand it or even find it tedious, yet those are plainly the core secrets to getting rich.

text: 人都是很懒的，习惯了一种状态，哪怕很痛苦，只要不危及生命，就懒得再去折腾。
en: People are lazy; having grown used to a state, however painful, as long as it does not threaten life they cannot be bothered to stir things up again.

text: 而且他身边的人，也会潜移默化地施压，让他维持在这种状态下，保持不变。
en: And those around him will also exert pressure imperceptibly, keeping him in that state, unchanged.

text: 但凡有一点点和过去不同，就会一哭二闹三上吊，让这件事回到原来的状态。
en: Should there be the slightest difference from the past, they will cry, throw tantrums, and threaten suicide, to drag the matter back to its original state.

text: 你说你不好好上班，要去跟那个什么老黄做抖音，孩子学费怎么办？
en: You say you will not work properly but go and do Douyin with that what's-his-name Huang — what about the child's school fees?

text: 你万一失败了怎么办？
en: What if you fail?

text: 你还是死了这条心吧，老娘不同意。
en: You had better drop that idea; I, your mother, do not consent.

text: 基本上，有家室的男人这辈子就定性了。
en: Basically, a man with a family is set for life.

text: 而且每分每秒都活在各种监视之中，不可能有例外。
en: And every minute he lives under all kinds of surveillance; there can be no exception.

text: 因为年少的时候，你可以为了一件事沉迷其中，不吃不喝通宵达旦就干成了。
en: Because in youth you can be obsessed with one thing, fasting and staying up all night, and get it done.

text: 但等你年纪大了，晚回一个电话，估计就要出事了。
en: But when you are older, a late return of a phone call will probably spell trouble.

text: 好不容易想做点自己的事情，门又要被敲开去应付他人的琐事。
en: Having at last wanted to do something of your own, the door is knocked open again to deal with others' trivial matters.

text: 你不帮忙，就是白眼狼。
en: If you do not help, you are a white-eyed wolf.

text: 要我说啊，到了中年，能躲就躲，躲各种饭局，躲各种压榨，躲各种拉扯纠缠。
en: To my mind, once at middle age, avoid what you can: avoid all kinds of banquets, all kinds of exploitation, all kinds of entanglement.

text: 不该说的话别说，不该去的地方就别去。
en: Do not say what should not be said; do not go where you should not go.

text: 想做什么就闷声去做，也别说什么真话。
en: Do what you want to do in silence, and do not speak the truth either.

text: 找个理由消失，然后自己去干就好了。
en: Find an excuse to disappear, then go and do it yourself.

text: 因为一旦你说了真话，无非就是被拉出来一顿批判，然后七大姑八大姨的又都来了。
en: Because once you speak the truth, you are simply dragged out for a round of criticism, and then all the aunts and uncles turn up again.

text: 人只要被凝视，就废掉了。
en: The moment a person is gazed upon, they are finished.

text: 更别扯什么别人会拉你一把了。
en: Never mind any talk of others lending you a hand.

text: 因为一个自身已经稀巴烂的人，哪怕有贵人来拉，也是拉不动的。
en: For a person who is already in a complete mess, even if a benefactor came to pull them up, they could not be moved.

text: 真的给你机会，你也会发现自己根本跟不上。
en: Truly, given the chance, you would find you simply cannot keep up.

text: 结果人家已经启动了，你却被各种琐事缠身，根本就无法融入其中。
en: In the end others have already started, while you are entangled in all kinds of trivialities and cannot fit in at all.

text: 人一旦习惯一个状态久了，基本上就定型了。
en: Once a person has grown used to a state for long, they are basically set.

text: 所以，年轻的时候真的别管成不成，一定要反复地去折腾。
en: So in youth, truly, never mind success or failure; you must stir things up again and again.

text: 要的不是结果有多大，而是习惯性地去拓宽自己的边界，习惯性地去接近“死亡地带”，让身边的每一个人都习惯你的安排，让他们无法侵入你的节奏。
en: What is wanted is not how big the result is, but habitually widening your own boundaries, habitually approaching the 'death zone', so that everyone around you grows used to your arrangements and cannot intrude upon your rhythm.

text: 反正我就是事业第一，任何干扰我事业的人，我都会直接拉黑，哪怕是我的亲人也不能干预这一条。
en: Anyway, I put career first; anyone who disturbs my career I block directly, and not even my own kin may interfere with this rule.

text: 人都是自我预言的。
en: People are self-fulfilling prophecies.

text: 你觉得你是谁，你会过什么样的生活，并且拼尽全力去反抗，你就能获得这样的权利。
en: You decide who you are and what kind of life you will lead, and if you fight it with all your might, you gain that right.

text: 而那些还在泥潭里挣扎的人，其实他们不是缺机会，也不是缺高人指点，他们缺的是一种“一无所有，但就是清楚明白自己要什么，然后咬住一件事不放”的决心。
en: As for those still struggling in the mire, in truth they lack neither opportunity nor the guidance of a master; what they lack is the resolve to be 'possessing nothing, yet knowing clearly what they want, and then holding fast to one thing without letting go'.

text: 写作费脑，码字不易，欢迎点赞，评论和关注，就当是对我的最大鼓励。
en: Writing tires the brain and typing is no easy task; likes, comments, and follows are welcome, as the greatest encouragement to me.
